summary: Phase 1 Display Settings & Orientation testing complete. All 21 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend features working: Display tab with aspect ratio presets (16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4, custom), orientation toggle with auto-dimension flip, live preview, format info label, and save functionality. Portrait and landscape modes render correctly for all slide types.
passed_tests: Backend: Root endpoint returns status 'running'
Backend: Health endpoint shows weather_api_configured=true, news_api_configured=true
Backend: GET /api/weather returns live data (Broken Clouds, 42°F)
Backend: GET /api/weather/extended returns current + 6-day forecast
Backend: GET /api/settings returns aspect_ratio field
Backend: PUT /api/settings accepts and saves aspect_ratio, display_orientation, display_width, display_height
Backend: Settings persist after update (GET after PUT verification)
Backend: All 4 preset ratios (16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4) update correctly
Backend: Custom dimensions update correctly
Frontend: Admin panel Display tab loads with all components
Frontend: All 5 aspect ratio preset buttons present (16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4, custom)
Frontend: Clicking 16:9 preset sets orientation=landscape, width=16, height=9
Frontend: Clicking 9:16 preset sets orientation=portrait, width=9, height=16
Frontend: Clicking 4:3 preset sets orientation=landscape, width=4, height=3
Frontend: Clicking 3:4 preset sets orientation=portrait, width=3, height=4
Frontend: Orientation toggle flips dimensions when switching landscape/portrait
Frontend: Custom width/height inputs are editable and set aspect_ratio to 'custom'
Frontend: Live preview changes shape/layout when orientation changes
Frontend: Format info label updates in real-time (Aspect Ratio, Orientation, Width, Height)
Frontend: Save Display Settings button persists changes via PUT /api/settings
Frontend: Settings tab still works correctly in admin panel
Frontend: Images tab still works correctly in admin panel
Frontend: Lobby display at / renders correctly in landscape mode
Frontend: Lobby display at / renders correctly in portrait mode
Frontend: Weather slide renders in portrait orientation (stacked layout, 3-col forecast)
Frontend: Local Attractions slide renders in portrait orientation (2-col grid)
Frontend: Events slide renders in portrait orientation (2-col grid)
Frontend: Slide rotation continues to work with all 4 slide types
test_credentials: No authentication required. Admin panel at /admin is open access.
seed_data_creation: None - using default images and live API data
